patterns: I'm from another country, how do I apply?
What are the admission requirements for international students?
responses: International students can apply online at [emu.edu/admissions/international](https://emu.edu/admissions/international). You'll need to submit transcripts, English proficiency scores, and a financial statement.
Visit EMU's international admissions page for application steps, deadlines, and required documents. They’ll guide you through the whole process.

patterns: How do I get a student visa?
responses: Once you're admitted, EMU will send your I-20 so you can apply for an F-1 student visa. Be sure to check your local U.S. embassy for next steps.
EMU helps international students get their I-20 after admission. Use that to schedule a visa appointment at the U.S. embassy or consulate.

patterns: Is there an orientation for international students?
Orientation for students from other countries
What support is there when I arrive?
responses: Yes! EMU offers a special orientation for international students before the semester starts. You'll get help with settling in, meeting others, and learning about campus.
International orientation is held prior to the regular semester and includes info on visas, academics, and student life. You’ll get details after you're admitted.

EMU accepts TOEFL, IELTS, and Duolingo English Test scores for international students. Minimum score requirements are listed at [emu.edu/admissions/international](https://emu.edu/admissions/international).
You’ll need to demonstrate English proficiency through one of the accepted tests—TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo. Check the website for score minimums.

patterns: Is there an office for international students?
responses: EMU’s International Student Services Office supports students with visa questions, cultural adjustment, and more. You can reach them at international@emu.edu.
Yes, international students get support through the ISS Office, including visa advising, events, and one-on-one help. They’re located in Campus Center Room 215.

patterns: Are international students allowed to work?
What jobs can I do as an F1 student?
responses: International students on F-1 visas can work up to 20 hours per week on campus during the school year. Off-campus work requires authorization.
Yes, you can work on campus! For off-campus jobs like internships (CPT/OPT), you’ll need to speak with the International Student Advisor for permission.
